title: RUN_ERROR codes
description: Sanitized `code` values of AG-UI RUN_ERROR events that the SPA maps to messages. The agent-service must map every other exception (MAF otherwise sends the exception class name) to INTERNAL; the SPA treats unknown codes as INTERNAL. The RUN_ERROR message is a fixed, non-sensitive text; the run ID is shown for support.

x-descriptions.APPROVAL_RESUME_REQUIRED: A pending approval must be answered (resume) before new input is accepted (MAF).
x-descriptions.APPROVAL_RESUME_NOT_FOUND: The approval is unknown or expired, e.g. after a service restart or another user's thread (MAF). Show 'proposal expired' and offer a retry chip.
x-descriptions.APPROVAL_RESUME_INVALID_RESPONSE: The approval response/editedArgs shape is invalid, e.g. editedArgs is not a full replacement (MAF).
x-descriptions.UNAUTHENTICATED: Missing, expired or invalid access token (HTTP 401).
x-descriptions.FORBIDDEN: The user may not access the project or thread (HTTP 403).
x-descriptions.NOT_FOUND: Thread, project or item not found (HTTP 404).
x-descriptions.THREAD_BUSY: Another run is active on this thread (HTTP 409).
x-descriptions.RUN_TIMEOUT: The run exceeded the run timeout (180 s).
x-descriptions.LLM_UNAVAILABLE: The LLM gateway is unreachable or returned an error.
x-descriptions.BACKLOG_UNAVAILABLE: backlog-api (MCP) is unreachable or returned an error.
x-descriptions.TOOL_VALIDATION_FAILED: Tool arguments stayed invalid after the allowed retries.
x-descriptions.INVALID_REQUEST: The AG-UI request itself is invalid.
x-descriptions.INTERNAL: Any other failure. Raw exception names and messages are never sent to the client.
